moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for licensure under this Chapter shall satisfy the Commission that he or she possesses the competency, honesty, truthfulness, integrity, good moral character, and general fitness, including mental and emotional fitness, necessary to protect the public interest

exams.name: Real Estate Broker License Examination
exams.notes: Examination may be administered orally, by computer, or by any other method the Commission deems appropriate. Applicant must pay actual cost of exam and administration.
exams.quote: any person who submits an application to the Commission in proper manner for a license as real estate broker shall be required to take an examination. The examination may be administered orally, by computer, or by any other method the Commission deems appropriate.

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued by the Commission under the provisions of this Chapter shall expire on the 30th day of June following issuance or on any other date that the Commission may determine and shall become invalid after that date unless reinstated.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The license renewal fee shall be forty-five dollars ($45.00) unless the Commission sets the fee at a higher amount by rule; however, the Commission shall not set the license renewal fee at an amount that exceeds sixty dollars ($60.00).

required.quote: An individual licensed as a real estate broker is required to complete eight hours of instruction a year during any license renewal period in subjects the Commission deems appropriate. Any licensee who fails to complete continuing education requirements pursuant to this section shall not actively engage in the business of real estate broker.

topical_requirements.quote: The Commission may, as part of the broker continuing education requirements, require real estate brokers-in-charge to complete during each annual license period a special continuing education course consisting of not more than four hours of instruction in subjects prescribed by the Commission.

available.quote: The Commission may issue a broker license to an applicant licensed in a foreign jurisdiction who has satisfied the requirements for licensure set out in G.S. 93A-4 or such other requirements as the Commission in its discretion may by rule require.

requirements.value: Commission may issue a full broker license to applicants licensed in a foreign jurisdiction meeting standard or alternative requirements. A limited broker's license is available for out-of-state licensees in good standing who only engage in commercial real estate transactions while affiliated with a NC resident broker.
requirements.quote: The Commission may issue a limited broker's license to a person or an entity from another state or territory of the United States without regard to whether that state or territory offers similar licensing privileges to residents in North Carolina if the person or entity satisfies all of the following: Is of good moral character and licensed as a real estate broker or salesperson in good standing in another state or territory of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any willful or negligent misrepresentation or omission of material fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any willful or negligent misrepresentation or any willful or negligent omission of material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promises likely to influence, persuade, or induce
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents or advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a course of misrepresentation or making of false promises through agents, advertising or otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties for whom he or she acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Provisional broker accepting commission from anyone other than broker-in-charge or employing broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or valuable consideration as a real estate broker on provisional status for the performance of any of the acts specified in this Article or Article 4 of this Chapter, from any person except his or her broker-in-charge or licensed broker by whom he or she is employed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing a real estate broker other than the one by whom the licensee is engaged without express consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the broker by whom he or she is engaged or associated, without the express knowledge and consent of the broker with whom he or she is associated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or remit money belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit any monies coming into his or her possession which belong to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unworthy or incompetent to act as a real estate broker in a manner endangering the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unworthy or incompetent to act as a real estate broker in a manner as to endanger the interest of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or valuable consideration to any person for acts performed in violation of this Chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a commission or valuable consideration to any person for acts or services performed in violation of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting improper, fraudulent, or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct which constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or undertaking any legal service constituting the practice of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or undertaking to perform any legal service, as set forth in G.S. 84-2.1, or any other acts constituting the practice of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling principals' money with own funds or failing to maintain required trust/escrow account
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or other property of his or her principals with his or her own or failure to maintain and deposit in a trust or escrow account in a bank as provided by subsection (g) of this section all money received by him or her as a real estate licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deliver a completed copy of any purchase agreement to the buyer and seller within a reasonable time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deliver, within a reasonable time, a completed copy of any purchase agreement or offer to buy and sell real estate to the buyer and to the seller.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deliver a detailed closing statement to the broker's client at the time a sales transaction is consummated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, at the time a sales transaction is consummated, to deliver to the broker's client a detailed and accurate closing statement showing the receipt and disbursement of all monies relating to the transaction about which the broker knows or reasonably should know.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule adopted by the Commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any rule adopted by the Commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by false or fraudulent representation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has obtained a license by false or fraudulent representation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or guilty/no contest plea for specified crimes involving dishonesty, fraud, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted or has entered a plea of guilty or no contest upon which final judgment is entered by a court of competent jurisdiction in this State, or any other state, of any misdemeanor or felony that involves false swearing, misrepresentation, deceit, extortion, theft, bribery, embezzlement, false pretenses, fraud, forgery, larceny, misappropriation of funds or property, perjury, or any other offense showing professional unfitness or involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating disciplinary provisions when selling, leasing, or buying the licensee's own property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any of the provisions of G.S. 93A-6(a) when selling, leasing, or buying the licensee's own property;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Broker's unlicensed exempt employee commits an act that would constitute a violation if committed by the broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The broker's unlicensed employee, who is exempt from the provisions of this Chapter under G.S. 93A-2(c)(6), has committed, in the regular course of business, any act which, if committed by the broker, would constitute a violation of G.S. 93A-6(a)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee disciplined in another licensed profession for fraud, theft, misrepresentation, or willful/negligent malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee, who is also licensed as an appraiser, attorney, home inspector, mortgage broker, general contractor, or member of another licensed profession or occupation, has been disciplined for an offense under any law involving fraud, theft, misrepresentation, breach of trust or fiduciary responsibility, or willful or negligent malpractice.

definition_quote.value: A real estate broker within the meaning of this Chapter is any person, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, association, or other business entity who for a compensation or valuable consideration or promise thereof lists or offers to list, sells or offers to sell, buys or offers to buy, auctions or offers to auction (specifically not including a mere crier of sales), or negotiates the purchase or sale or exchange of real estate, or who leases or offers to lease, or who sells or offers to sell leases of whatever character, or rents or offers to rent any real estate or the improvement thereon, for others.
